identity.title: Add deterministic governance regression delta between runs

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: After the EverRun dogfood baseline, add a deterministic post-run comparison of governance facts between two runs so regressions such as authorized-to-unknown, validation passed-to-partial, or within-budget-to-exceeded are visible without adding generic observability scoring or runtime gating.
human_pressure.why_now: Repeated dogfood is more valuable when Ailuros can compare governance behavior across runs rather than inspect each run in isolation.
do_not_misread: This is a governance fact delta, not latency/token/output-similarity analytics.
A delta is descriptive evidence, not an automatic release gate.

machine_core.goal: Add a deterministic, source-neutral governance delta read model between two existing run projections.
red_lines: No runtime control or release blocking.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
invariants: Both source runs remain unchanged and independently inspectable.
Unknown is a first-class transition state.
Comparison uses deterministic normalized governance facts only.

observable_effect.assertion: Ailuros emits stable governance-field transitions between two runs without mutating either source run.

proofs.assertion: Focused tests prove regression, improvement, unchanged and unknown transitions.

failure_semantics: Missing comparison facts remain unknown rather than defaulting to unchanged or clean.
Incomparable dimensions are explicit rather than silently dropped.

steps.title: Define minimal governance delta model
details: Represent two run ids and explicit governance dimension transitions.
Keep values aligned with existing projection and coverage semantics.

steps.title: Compare governance facts
details: Compare governed/native outcome, validation, scope and available authority/approval/budget/coverage facts.

steps.title: Prove deterministic transitions
details: Add focused regression, improvement, unchanged and unknown cases.
Keep producer identity out of comparison semantics.

steps.title: Document dogfood usage
details: Document how repeated EverRun dogfood runs can be compared without turning the feature into a release gate.

acceptance: Two run projections can be compared without mutating either run.
Regression, improvement, unchanged and unknown transitions are explicit.
No automatic release gate, score or producer-specific branch is introduced.

must_check: Delta facts are deterministic and source-neutral.
reject_if: The implementation adds automatic release gating or live runtime control.
Unknown is collapsed into unchanged or clean.
The comparator branches on EverRun identity.
A new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path is introduced for non-capability reasons.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: The pack creates a focused comparator test and runs the full suite because regression is a new cross-run read-model boundary.
